Its ``mixed_precision`` structured-data name turns on autocast for training, and its ``train_metrics_full_pass`` structured-data name chooses how the per-epoch training metrics are measured: off (the default), they are accumulated from the training batches themselves, in the mode and precision training uses, while the weights change through the epoch; on, the model is re-evaluated over the whole training loader after each epoch in eval mode and full precision, which costs one more pass over the data. records.context: metadata column naming each sample's batch, such as a laboratory microplate or an imaging week. Each fold's training side then drops every sample from a batch present in its validation side, so a held-out sample is never scored by a model that saw its batch (the not-same-compound-or-batch rule when ``group_column`` is a compound). records.translation: हर नमूने के बैच का नाम देने वाला मेटाडेटा कॉलम, जैसे कोई प्लेट या इमेजिंग सप्ताह। तब हर fold का train पक्ष उस बैच के सभी नमूने हटा देता है जो उसके validation पक्ष में मौजूद है, ताकि अलग रखे गए नमूने को कभी ऐसा मॉडल स्कोर न करे जिसने उसका बैच देखा हो (जब ``group_column`` कोई यौगिक हो तो यह न-समान-यौगिक-या-बैच नियम है)। fold तालिका में ``held_out_batches``, ``n_train_excluded`` और ``train_classes_missing`` जुड़ जाते हैं।
